title: Procuring Parts for Algal Shaker
author: Jakub Nedbal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdtwi6pe

steps.title: Download Parts and Tools List
steps.instruction: Download the 'OrbitalShaker_PartsList.xlsx' file to obtain the comprehensive list of parts and tools required for the assembly.

steps.title: Procure Orbital Shaker
steps.instruction: Acquire an orbital shaker with a platform larger than 22 cm × 20 cm to ensure the heatsink, fans, and stand-offs fit. A basic model (e.g., KJ-201BD) can be used.

steps.title: Source Electronic Components
steps.instruction: Purchase the electronic parts listed in the 'Electronics Parts' tab of the spreadsheet. Ensure capacitors have rated voltage and dielectrics no lower than the listed specifications.

substeps.instruction: Substitute 0603-size resistors, BSS138W transistors, pin headers, shunt jumpers, or fuses if necessary.

steps.title: Source Mechanical Parts and Fixings
steps.instruction: Procure the mechanical parts and fixings listed in the 'Fixings' tab, including 50 mm-long M4 standoffs.

substeps.instruction: For imperial thread requirements, substitute M4 with #8-32 UNC and M3 with #4-40 UNC.

Specifically for imperial: use 4× #8-32 UNC nuts, 8× #8-32 UNC washers, 4× #8-32 UNC 1/2"-long pan head screws, 4× #4-40 UNC 3/8"-long countersunk screws, and 4× 2-inch #8-32 male-female standoffs (Keystone 1964).

steps.title: Procure LED Illuminator Components
steps.instruction: Obtain the LED strips, heatsink, cooling fans, wiring, wall socket plug-in power supply, and 24-hour time switch.

substeps.instruction: For non-UK regions: Use a 30V/1A power supply with a 2.1mm DC connector and a certified 24-hour socket timer suitable for the local line voltage.
For non-metric regions: Use cables roughly equivalent to AWG 21 (0.5 mm² cross-section).
Obtain a 4 mm (5/32") thick clear acrylic sheet (or polycarbonate).

steps.title: Prepare Assembly Tools
steps.instruction: Gather the tools listed in the 'Tools' tab, including workshop tools, stationaries, soldering equipment, and cutting/drilling tools.

substeps.instruction: For imperial thread users: Replace the 4 mm drill bit with a #16 or #18 drill bit and use a #4-40 UNC thread tap instead of the M3 tap.
Select a transparent solvent-based multi-purpose glue that retains flexibility and cures via evaporation (do not use PVA or superglue).
Ensure access to an FDM 3D printer for the controller case.

steps.title: Order Custom Printed Circuit Board (PCB)
steps.instruction: Order the double-sided PCB with plated through-holes using the Gerber files from the project GitHub page.

substeps.instruction: Download the 'LEDregulator.zip' archive containing Gerber files.
Upload the zip file to a PCB manufacturer (e.g., Seeed Technology Fusion PCB service).
Keep default manufacturing settings; an order of five PCBs is recommended to minimize waste.
Complete shipping and billing details and wait for delivery.
